description:
Upstream `stdin-buffer.test.ts` is 422 lines (port-map §14.1).
Our current FSM has 20 tests covering the MVP shape. Gaps:

- SGR mouse (`\e[<...M`) — currently falls through to CSI which
  extracts the sequence but doesn't mark it as mouse. Add
  mouse detection so downstream can route it separately.
- Old-style X11 mouse: `ESC M` + 3 bytes (all opaque).
- DCS / APC / PM / SS3 handling — we handle SS3 for 3-byte
  sequences; DCS/APC/PM need ST terminator detection (same
  pattern as OSC).
- Bracketed paste with Unicode in the content — verify UTF-8
  codepoints inside the 200~/201~ markers come through
  correctly when split across chunks.
- Flush/destroy semantics: upstream has an explicit teardown
  that flushes any pending buffer. Ours terminates via
  GenServer.stop. Add a `flush/1` convenience + test.
- Kitty press/release/repeat events routed via the FSM: ensure
  sequence boundaries don't break modifier/event reporting.

TDD:
- Every scenario from stdin-buffer.test.ts → ExUnit test.
- Mouse decoding (SGR + X11).
- DCS/APC/PM ST-terminated sequences.
- UTF-8 across paste-marker boundaries.
title: StdinFSM parity with upstream stdin-buffer.test.ts
